name: Bitdeer Clarington data center site
summary: Bitdeer development site at Clarington, Monroe County, Ohio, with 570 MW of power under contract with an unnamed local utility. In October 2025 Bitdeer planned a bitcoin mining data center whose core infrastructure would be designed for easy conversion to AI, targeting substation energization in the first half of 2027. Through 2026 the site stayed in design and preparation: legal proceedings filed by neighboring company American Heavy Plate Solutions left the timing of power and construction uncertain, and Bitdeer's listed use for the site moved from HPC/AI in February 2026 to colocation and crypto mining by August 2026.

location.note: Bitdeer names only Clarington, Ohio. Coordinates are the village point from its Wikipedia article, which also gives the county; the site itself is not pinpointed.

metrics.note: Power under contract with an unnamed local utility. In October 2025 Bitdeer said the utility confirmed the full amount would be available by the end of Q3 2026; by 2026 the ready-for-service date was listed as to be updated.

milestones.note: Bitdeer reported it had begun design and layout planning for the site; this is the earliest source opened for this record, not necessarily the first disclosure.
Bitdeer first cited legal proceedings by neighboring American Heavy Plate Solutions as a risk to the timing of power and construction in the sources opened.
October 2025 target for completing power and data center infrastructure, after substation energization in the first half of 2027. From February 2026 Bitdeer listed the timing as to be updated.

power_sources.description: 570 MW contracted from an unnamed local utility, with a planned substation.
